eval_dimensions.name: Phase 3 Presentation Gate
eval_dimensions.description: The ranked ADR draft is presented via AskUserQuestion with the four documented options — never a plain-text 'does this look right?' — so the supervisor's decision to accept, redirect, deepen, or re-evaluate blocks execution.

eval_dimensions.name: Advocate Status-Line Handling
eval_dimensions.description: Each Phase 1 advocate's trailing status line (DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS / NEEDS_CONTEXT / BLOCKED) is parsed and drives a specific recovery action — re-dispatch on NEEDS_CONTEXT, inline fallback with a disclosed rigor-reduction on BLOCKED — rather than being ignored or treated as uniform success.

eval_dimensions.name: Synthesis Fact-Checks Before Ranking
eval_dimensions.description: Phase 2 either dispatches the adr-reviewer agent to fact-check at least 3 claims per advocate before ranking, or explicitly documents the accepted inline-synthesis skip — it never ranks options straight off advocate claims with zero verification and zero disclosure.

evals.name: Presentation gate fires with the four documented options
evals.description: After Phase 2 synthesis, Phase 3 must block on AskUserQuestion rather than asking 'Should I proceed with this recommendation?' as prose.
evals.input: /Dev10x:adr-evaluate — Topic: state management approach, Options: 1/2/3 evaluated, draft ADR ready to present

assertions.signal: gate1_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion is called after the draft ADR and ranked recommendation are presented
gate1_correct_options — options are exactly 'Accept recommendation', 'Choose a different option', 'Request deeper analysis on specific aspect', 'Revise options and re-evaluate'
gate1_no_plain_text — no inline 'Does this recommendation work for you?' substitutes for the widget

evals.name: NEEDS_CONTEXT status re-dispatches only the affected advocate
evals.description: When one advocate's trailing status line reads NEEDS_CONTEXT: <what>, that advocate alone is re-dispatched with the requested context inlined; the other advocates are not stalled or re-run.
evals.input: /Dev10x:adr-evaluate with 3 advocates dispatched; Option 2's advocate returns 'NEEDS_CONTEXT: ADR-014 full text'

assertions.signal: redispatch_uses_tool — a second Agent() dispatch targets only the Option 2 advocate with ADR-014 content inlined
no_stall_other_advocates — Options 1 and 3's advocacy results are carried into Phase 2 synthesis unchanged, not re-dispatched

evals.name: BLOCKED status runs that advocacy inline and discloses reduced rigor
evals.description: When an advocate returns BLOCKED: <reason>, the skill runs that option's advocacy from the main session instead of re-dispatching, and the final ADR draft names the reason so reviewers know that option received less independent scrutiny.
evals.input: /Dev10x:adr-evaluate — Option 3's advocate returns 'BLOCKED: permission denied reading migrations/'

assertions.signal: inline_fallback_runs — Option 3's advocacy is produced inline by the main session rather than left empty
Final ADR draft (Phase 3 presentation) discloses that Option 3 received reduced rigor and names the BLOCKED reason

evals.name: Synthesis fact-checks 3+ claims per advocate, or the inline-skip is explicit
evals.description: Phase 2 either launches adr-reviewer which fact-checks at least 3 claims per advocate by reading cited files, or — when skipping the sub-agent for a simple evaluation — the skill's own synthesis still reads the cited files rather than accepting claims unverified.
evals.input: /Dev10x:adr-evaluate with 2 advocates, each citing 4 file:line claims

assertions.signal: fact_check_reads_cited_files — at least 3 of each advocate's cited file:line claims are read (via adr-reviewer Agent dispatch or inline Read calls) before the ranking is produced
no_unverified_ranking — the ranked recommendation in Phase 3 is not asserted from advocate claims alone with zero file reads

should_trigger: /Dev10x:adr-evaluate with a topic and 2-4 competing architectural options
Running architecture trade-off analysis needing structured multi-perspective evaluation
should_not_trigger: Creating a simple ADR with one obvious approach (use Dev10x:adr)
Making a code change with no architecture impact
